The Most High is building this kingdom right now in the age of their decadence, and everybody will be made to follow this Bible, bend to the will of God, or die.

note.label: The Image of Dysfunction or the Image of God Which One Are You?

precepts.why:
Daniel 7:27 says “the kingdom and dominion, and the greatness of the kingdom under the whole heaven, shall be given to the people of the saints of the most High, whose kingdom is an everlasting kingdom”. That is why Daniel 2:44 says the same: “And in the days of these kings shall the God of heaven set up a kingdom, which shall never be destroyed”.

The days of these kings are the same kings of Daniel 7, the thrones cast down in Armageddon when Christ comes back to smash and destroy and set his people up in rulership. The kingdom the God of heaven sets up is you, sisters and brothers, the nation of Israel, and it is starting now. A lot of people don't like that, but the Most High is building this kingdom right now, in the age of their decadence.

“and the kingdom shall not be left to other people, but it shall break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms”. The Most High's kingdom, the nation of Israel with Christ and the Most High and the angels leading us, shall break the nations and make them bend to the will of God, or death. Everybody is going to be made to follow the words of this Bible, its laws and commandments. Full stop.

“and it shall stand for ever.” That is the everlasting kingdom of Daniel 7:27. Remember these words: the kingdom the Lord is setting up shall stand for ever, and we are supposed to be in the image of understanding that, not the image of dysfunction. All the wealth of the nations under the whole heaven, the whole planet, has to be given back to Israel, including the nations themselves.

Where we were made dysfunctional and called coon and spear-chucker, everything except Israelites, the Lord will beautify the meek. precepts.why:
“Yet the number of the children of Israel shall be as the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured nor numbered; and it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people, there it shall be said unto them, Ye are the sons of the living God.”

The place where it was said, ye are not my people, is the place where we were made to be dysfunctional, where we were made a mess, where they called us coon and spear-chucker. They called us everything except the Israelites. In that very place the Most High is going to beautify the meek with salvation, and there it shall be said, ye are the sons of the living God. That is Daniel 7:27: the kingdom under the whole heaven given “to the people of the saints of the most High”.

The Lord is going to punish the nations for what they called us and did to us, because we are God's heritage. Those who put their nasty, mangy hands on us touched the apple of his eye, and they are going to pay for it. Our brothers and sisters were hung and suffered all kinds of evil, and the Most High has the chart on everything. The Lord allowed it to happen, and he is still going to make them pay for doing it.

precepts.text: For this same purpose have I raised thee up, that I might shew my power in thee. As with Pharaoh, so with Esau: God fattens him up with weapons, technology, and pride like a turkey before the holiday, hardens him so he cannot resist, and destroys him so his name is declared through all the earth. Who hath resisted his will? Pharaoh wanted to let Israel go and the Lord hardened his heart. Nay but, O man, who art thou that repliest against God? Esau was formed as the fitting vessel for God's destruction; one vessel is for wine and one for the bowels. You had better be glad you are the Israelites, because after slavery, Jim Crow, and lynchings, dying with the same man who did it is crazy.

precepts.why:
The Lord allows the nations to afflict us and still makes them pay, and who can resist his will? That is the argument of Romans 9. “For the scripture saith unto Pharaoh, Even for this same purpose have I raised thee up, that I might shew my power in thee, and that my name might be declared throughout all the earth.” The same purpose for which God raised up Pharaoh is the purpose for which he is raising up Esau: to show his power by channeling his destructive anger through him, and to get his glory by destroying the man everybody is worshipping, so they will all know the Most High is the real power.

“Therefore hath he mercy on whom he will have mercy, and whom he will he hardeneth.” He raised up Pharaoh to resist God, and he makes Esau do the same. He is fattening Esau up with weapons, technology, power and pride, the way you fatten a turkey before one of their wicked holidays, and then he will cut him down.

“Thou wilt say then unto me, Why doth he yet find fault? For who hath resisted his will?” How can he find fault with the man when he gave him all the weapons and made him resist? Esau cannot resist the will of God, and neither could Pharaoh. Pharaoh wanted to let the Israelites go, and the Lord hardened his heart.

“Nay but, O man, who art thou that repliest against God? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it, Why hast thou made me thus? Hath not the potter power over the clay, of the same lump to make one vessel unto honour, and another unto dishonour?” Esau was formed as the fitting vessel for God's destruction; one vessel is for wine and one is for the bowels.

So you had better be glad you are the Israelites. After slavery, Jim Crow and the lynchings, to die with the same man who did it to you would be crazy. The kingdom goes to the saints of the Most High, and the vessel of dishonour is broken.

precepts.text: I beheld till the thrones were cast down. Daniel said he looked in the visions and he saw when the thrones — these same kingdoms that we are reading about here in the second chapter, he is bringing it out again in the seventh chapter with the dream. I beheld till the thrones were cast down, until the rulerships were destroyed. And the Ancient of days did sit. And God's judgment sat. Christ's judgment sat. And the Ancient of days, that is the Most High. Did sit. That is telling you something right there. Did sit. He had a body in order for him to sit. He had legs. He had a garment on. He sat down. And he had hair on his head. Whose garment was white as snow. He had a garment on because he had a body. You are talking about something, God does not have a body. Celestial bodies. God has that. If he had on a garment, he had a body. And the hair of his head — and if he had hair on his head, he had to have a body. In order for you to recognise that he sat down, you had to see him looking like a human, so you can understand. I know the Most High is the Most High, but he had a form for us to be able to describe him. He did not say he was a lizard. He did not say that he was some other creature. He said that he sat down and judged. So he had to be looking like a man type of figure, so you can understand. Like Exodus says, the Lord is a man of war. So he is looking like a man figure with all his power. The Ancient of days, meaning he was here before days began. That is the Most High. Whose garment was white as snow. He was not like a ghost or a sheet flying in the wind. He had a garment on that was on his body. And the hair of his head like the pure wool. Like the pure negro hair. Like the pure wool. That is our king. That is our creator. And his son looks just like him. So that is what is coming to us. So Daniel was looking and he saw these four great kings destroyed. He saw them destroyed, and then the Most High sat down and opened up the books and judged them. That is how that goes.
precepts.point: So when all of these kings are about to be done, and we are in the last part of this beast right now in America, listen. Shall the God of heaven set up a kingdom, which shall never be destroyed. So all of the other kingdoms are going to be destroyed. All of the other kingdoms were destroyed.

note.label: The Exponential Maturation In The Days Of Decadence

precepts.why:
“And in the days of these kings shall the God of heaven set up a kingdom”. These kings are all the kingdoms that ruled on this planet, the great image of Nebuchadnezzar's dream: Babylon the head of gold, then Persia, then Greece, then Rome, and America comes up last. We are in the last part of this beast right now, in America. All the other kingdoms were destroyed, and these are going to be destroyed.

Daniel brings the same kingdoms out again in the seventh chapter with his dream: “I beheld till the thrones were cast down”. Until the rulerships were destroyed. Daniel looked and saw these four great kings destroyed, and then the Most High sat down, opened the books and judged them. That is how it goes.

“and the Ancient of days did sit”. The Ancient of days means he was here before days began; that is the Most High, and his judgment sat. Did sit: that tells you something. He had a body in order to sit. He had legs, he had a garment on, he sat down, and he had hair on his head. People say God doesn't have a body; he has a celestial body. I know the Most High is the Most High, but he had a form so we could describe him. He didn't say he was a lizard or some other creature; he sat down and judged, so he looked like a man type of figure, the way the Lord is called a man of war.

“whose garment was white as snow”: he wasn't like a ghost or a sheet flying in the wind; the garment was on his body. “and the hair of his head like the pure wool”: like pure negro hair, white and woolly, black men's hair. That is our king, that is our creator, and his Son looks just like him. That is what is coming to us.

So in the days of these kings, while they are in rulership and the decadence is setting in, the Most High is causing us to get ourselves together, and persecution is part of that. When the thrones are cast down and the Ancient of days sits in judgment, the God of heaven sets up the kingdom that “shall not be left to other people”, other races and nations, but is for the twelve tribes of Israel, and it “shall break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms”. That is what Christ is going to do.

precepts.text: This leopard represents the Greeks. Four wings of a fowl: four major militaries. Four heads: four major generals; Ptolemy took over Egypt, Seleucus Syria, Lysimachus Thrace, Cassander Macedonia. When Revelation 13:2 says like unto a leopard, it was like the Greek Empire; it's not the actual Greek Empire, but it has elements of it. His feet were as the feet of a bear: the Persians and Medes, that was their symbol. His mouth as the mouth of a lion: Babylon.
precepts.point: He shall also stand up against the prince of princes: the prince of princes is Christ. But he shall be broken without hand: Christ going to destroy him.
precepts.why:
“After this I beheld, and lo another, like a leopard, which had upon the back of it four wings of a fowl; the beast had also four heads; and dominion was given to it.” This leopard represents the Greeks. The four wings of a fowl are four major militaries. The four heads are the four major generals: Ptolemy took over Egypt, Seleucus Syria, Lysimachus Thrace, and Cassander Macedonia.

That is why Daniel 8:23 says “in the latter time of their kingdom”: it is the kingdom of Grecia carried on into the last days. When Revelation 13:2 says the beast was “like unto a leopard”, it is like the Greek Empire. It is not the actual Greek Empire, but it has elements of it.

The rest of the beast is read the same way from Daniel 7: “his feet were as the feet of a bear” is the Persians and Medes, whose symbol that was, and “his mouth as the mouth of a lion” is Babylon. So the king of fierce countenance who stands up in the latter time carries the marks of all these kingdoms, with the dragon's power behind him.

precepts.text: The kingdom and dominion, and the greatness of the kingdom under the whole heaven, shall be given to the people of the saints of the Most High: that's the whole earth, exactly what the tablets said.
precepts.point: The blessings of thy father have prevailed above the blessings of my progenitors: what God promised to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob was not yet fulfilled in their day, but Joseph ruled all Egypt. Canaan wasn't ours yet, and Joseph already had the crown.
precepts.why:
The records of the Spanish explorers tell what the Indians' own sorcerers had said: that the God of these children of Israel is the true God, that everything inscribed on their tablets is true, that at the end of days they will be lords of all the nations of the earth, and that after one nation comes bringing many things to that land, these children of Israel will go forth from where they are and reign over the whole earth as they once did. That is what the nations don't want.

Daniel says the very same thing: “And the kingdom and dominion, and the greatness of the kingdom under the whole heaven, shall be given to the people of the saints of the most High, whose kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and all dominions shall serve and obey him.” Under the whole heaven is the whole earth, exactly what the tablets said.

This is the blessing Jacob put on Joseph's head in Genesis 49. “The blessings of thy father have prevailed above the blessings of my progenitors”: what God promised to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob was not yet fulfilled in their day, Canaan was not yet theirs, but Joseph already ruled all Egypt. Joseph wore the crown before the kingdom came, a picture of the dominion that will be given to the saints in the last days.

note.label: The Superiority of the Chosen People

precepts.why:
Daniel says the beast shall “think to change times and laws”, and the plan laid out at the 1969 meeting of the order, delivered by Dr. Richard Day, spoke of changing laws and customs in so many words. One of its points was blending all religions: the old religions will have to go. Old means us, teaching the old ways. That is Jeremiah's old paths.

“Thus saith the Lord, Stand ye in the ways, and see, and ask for the old paths, where is the good way, and walk therein, and ye shall find rest for your souls.” The old path is the good way, the laws and commandments of God, and you find rest for your souls in it. Getting rid of the old religions means getting rid of us and bringing all nations together as one, Babylon together again, with all the old teachings of the laws and commandments of God taken out.

“But they said, We will not walk therein.” Our people say, no, we don't want to; Christianity is better, I can do what I want.

That is why the new religion they planned would take something from all the old ones so people could feel at home in it. Christianity is a doctrine of adaptation: do what the world does, go to the club, do what you want, as long as you believe in white Jesus. Islam is a doctrine of adaptation: no pork, but eat everything else, and women wear pants. In the truth you can't eat what you want, wear what you want and do what you want. That is the old way, and that is what they say has to go. Even Israelites are starting to adapt, going to the clubs and wearing snap-on fringes they can take off and put back on.

So changing times and laws is not only the calendar. It is turning our people from the old paths, where the rest for our souls is found.

note.label: Popular Persuasions: Fighting Against Heaven Defending Earth

precepts.why:
Daniel shows again what heaven means: “And the kingdom and dominion, and the greatness of the kingdom under the whole heaven, shall be given to the people of the saints of the most High.” That is rulership. The greatness of the kingdom under the whole heaven is dominion over the nations, and it is given to the saints of the Most High, Israel.

So when Isaiah says “How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! how art thou cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations!”, it is the fall of a ruler from his dominion. How did you fall from rulership? Lucifer is the king of Babylon, the oppressor who weakened the nations with his bombs, his lies and his fornication.

He said in his heart, “I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of God: I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north”, North America, and “I will be like the most High.” “Yet thou shalt be brought down to hell, to the sides of the pit.”

Put the two together. The rulership he grasped at, he loses, and the kingdom and dominion under the whole heaven is given to the people of the saints of the Most High. It is not an angel cast out of the sky; it is the man, this so-called white man, America, brought down, and Israel lifted up to rule.

precepts.text: A fourth beast, dreadful and terrible, and strong exceedingly, diverse from all the beasts that were before it: Daniel saw the lion of Babylon, the bear of Persia and Media, and the leopard of the Greeks, but the fourth beast was different from all of them, and he did not understand it.
precepts.point: The eagle, whom thou sawest come up from the sea, is the kingdom which was seen in the vision of thy brother Daniel, but it was not expounded unto him. This last kingdom Daniel never understood, nor saw the animal symbol; the angel revealed it to Esdras: it is the eagle. We are living in the United States of America; what is their symbol? The eagle. This eagle has three heads: Rome, America, Britain.
precepts.why:
Ezra saw “an eagle, which had twelve feathered wings, and three heads” come up from the sea, and she “spread her wings over all the earth.” Then the angel told him: “The eagle, whom thou sawest come up from the sea, is the kingdom which was seen in the vision of thy brother Daniel. But it was not expounded unto him, therefore now I declare it unto thee.”

Go back to Daniel and see what he saw: “a fourth beast, dreadful and terrible, and strong exceedingly; and it had great iron teeth: it devoured and brake in pieces, and stamped the residue with the feet of it: and it was diverse from all the beasts that were before it; and it had ten horns.” Daniel saw the lion, the symbol of Babylon; the bear of the Persians and Medes; the leopard of the Greeks. But this fourth one was diverse, different from every beast before it, and Daniel never understood it and never saw its animal symbol.

What was hidden from Daniel was revealed to Ezra: the fourth kingdom is the eagle. We are living in the United States of America, and what is their symbol? The eagle. This eagle has three heads: Rome, America, Britain.

That is the same beast of Daniel 7:25 that “shall speak great words against the most High, and shall wear out the saints of the most High, and think to change times and laws.” So the fourth beast is not some kingdom long gone. It is the eagle kingdom we live under now, the one that devoured, brake in pieces and stamped the residue, and wore our people out in slavery.

precepts.text: This month shall be unto you the beginning of months: it shall be the first month of the year to you.
precepts.point: And they shall be given into his hand until a time and times and the dividing of time: time is singular, times is plural, and the dividing is the half; that is three and a half, as Revelation explains.
precepts.why:
The “he” of Daniel 7:25 is the fourth kingdom Daniel did not understand, which the angel revealed to Ezra as the eagle with three heads: Rome, America and Britain. Daniel says “he shall speak great words against the most High”, blasphemies, “and shall wear out the saints of the most High”. Like a pair of sneakers worn so long you cannot tell what brand they were, slavery wore us out until nobody recognizes us as the Israelites, the glorious and mighty sons and daughters of God. People go, those are some damn black Africans. Now you look at a negro Latino and you go, I don't know what the hell that is. That thing, a negro, was made up, and nobody can identify them people as a race.

Then the part about time: he shall “think to change times and laws”. To see what he changed, go to what God set. “This month shall be unto you the beginning of months: it shall be the first month of the year to you.”

God himself appointed the first month of the year for Israel, at the time he brought them out of Egypt. The new year is not a date man picks. It is an ordinance of God, and it is one of the times the fourth beast thought to change.

precepts.text: This day came ye out in the month Abib. Abib is the first month of the ancient Hebrew calendar, corresponding to parts of March and April; the word literally means ear of grain, when the barley is ripe but still soft, marking the start of the spring harvest. So when you see Israelites celebrating Passover in the winter, they do not know what they are talking about. They changed the new year from spring to the dead of winter; that is what God is warning us about in Daniel 7:25.
precepts.point: And they shall be given into his hand until a time and times and the dividing of time: time is singular, times is plural, and the dividing is the half; that is three and a half, as Revelation explains.
precepts.why:
Which month did God make the beginning of months? “This day came ye out in the month Abib.” Abib is the name of the first month of the ancient Hebrew calendar, generally corresponding to parts of March and April in the modern Gregorian calendar: the end of March into the beginning of April, the spring season.

The word comes from Hebrew and literally means ear of grain, young green ears, sprouting. It refers to the stage when barley is ripe but still soft, marking the start of the spring harvest. God's new year begins in spring, when the barley comes in.

So when you see Israelites celebrating Passover in the winter, they don't know what the hell they are talking about. The new year was changed from spring to the dead of winter. That is what God warns us about in Daniel 7:25: he shall “think to change times and laws”.

precepts.text: Are there not twelve hours in the day? What the white man has done is daylight savings time, where they change time forward or backward. They play with times.
precepts.point: And they shall be given into his hand until a time and times and the dividing of time: time is singular, times is plural, and the dividing is the half; that is three and a half, as Revelation explains.
precepts.why:
“Jesus answered, Are there not twelve hours in the day? If any man walk in the day, he stumbleth not, because he seeth the light of this world.” Christ says there are twelve hours in the day.

What the white man has done is make something called daylight saving time, where they move time forward or backward. They play with times. Daniel said this man would “think to change times and laws”, and here is one more way he has done it: even the hours of the day are shifted at his word.

God set the day by his light; man changes the clock. That is one of the times the fourth kingdom has changed on the whole world.

precepts.text: And God made two great lights: the greater light to rule the day, the sun; and the lesser light to rule the night, the moon. In the Bible the moon was made full; the white man says no, count from when it is black, or from the sliver of light. That is not biblical. You have Israelites that base holy days on when you cannot see the moon; we did that at one time, so we are not hating, we are enlightening.
precepts.point: And they shall be given into his hand until a time and times and the dividing of time: time is singular, times is plural, and the dividing is the half; that is three and a half, as Revelation explains.

“And God said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years”. The lights in the heavens were set by God to mark the times.

“And God made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: he made the stars also.” The greater light is the sun, and the lesser light is the moon. When Adam and Eve were created, the moon was what they call the full moon; that was the beginning. God made two great lights. It does not say the moon was dark with only a little bit of light.

What did the white man do? He said, count from when the moon is black, or, as some say, from when it has that one sliver of light. That is not biblical. In the Bible the moon was made full. It confuses a lot of people, and there are Israelites who base holy days on when you cannot see the moon. We did that at one time too, so we are not hating; we are enlightening.

These lights are also how God swears to keep Israel. Jeremiah 31 speaks of the Lord “which giveth the sun for a light by day, and the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night”, and says, “If those ordinances depart from before me, saith the Lord, then the seed of Israel also shall cease from being a nation before me for ever.” Nobody can get rid of the sun, the moon or the stars, so Israel remains his people.

precepts.why:
“And he exerciseth all the power of the first beast before him, and causeth the earth and them which dwell therein to worship the first beast, whose deadly wound was healed.” The first beast was Rome. You may think nobody worships Rome today. Really?

Look at the days of the week. Sunday is the sun, Monday the moon, Tuesday Mars, Wednesday Mercury, Thursday Jupiter, Friday Venus and Saturday Saturn. Now the months: January is named after the Roman god Janus, with two faces looking to the future and the past. February comes from Februalia, a Roman festival of purification and atonement. March is Mars, the Roman god of war. April comes from aperire, to open, like flowers in spring. May is the goddess Maia, June is the goddess Juno. July was Quintilis, the fifth month, until Julius Caesar named it after his family, and August was Sextilis until the emperor Augustus named it after himself. September, October, November and December come from the Latin for seven, eight, nine and ten, so December still says it is the tenth month while it is counted as the twelfth.

Our lives run on Roman time. That is the whole earth worshiping the first beast, and it is how he changed times. He changed laws too, like the Sabbath: the Bible says the Sabbath is the seventh day of the week, and he says the first.

Daniel goes on: “and they shall be given into his hand until a time and times and the dividing of time.” Time is one, times is two, and the dividing is a half: three and a half. Revelation 11:11 says “after three days and an half the Spirit of life from God entered into them”; Revelation 12:6 counts “a thousand two hundred and threescore days”, which is 1,260 divided by 360, three and a half; and in Revelation 12:14 the woman “is nourished for a time, and times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent.” We are nourished by America: our food, drink, clothes and education all come from the one John calls the serpent and Moses calls the enemy: “Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the Lord shall send against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things”.

Yet God has not cast away his people. “Hath God cast away his people? God forbid.” The new covenant is with the house of Israel and the house of Judah. As long as the sun, the moon and the stars remain, God will not cast away the seed of Jacob; “I will cause their captivity to return, and have mercy on them.”

precepts.text: Because of the voice of the great words which the horn spake, the beast was slain and his body given to the burning flame. The horn is America and the voice is its media, heard even on channels in Cuba. Revelation 18:8: her plagues come in one day and she shall be utterly burned with fire, and the kings who lived deliciously with her lament when they see the smoke.
precepts.point: The serpent cast out of his mouth water as a flood after the woman. His mouth is the media, every aspect of it so-called Jewish owned, and the water is lies. The flood is to draw the twelve tribes into Christian and democratic lies.
precepts.why:
Daniel saw it too: “I beheld then because of the voice of the great words which the horn spake”. Write this down: the horn is America. The voice is their media today, and it goes worldwide; even in Cuba there was American news on certain channels.

“I beheld even till the beast was slain, and his body destroyed, and given to the burning flame.” Now he calls the horn the beast, and it is destined to be destroyed. Revelation 18:8 is the precept: “Therefore shall her plagues come in one day, death, and mourning, and famine; and she shall be utterly burned with fire: for strong is the Lord God who judgeth her.” That is the body given to the burning flame.

“And the kings of the earth, who have committed fornication and lived deliciously with her, shall bewail her, and lament for her, when they shall see the smoke of her burning”. They will cry for this horn, this America.

So the mouth that casts out the flood after the woman is the same voice of great words that brings the beast to the burning flame.

They wore us out in shackles, buck breaking, and sunup-to-sundown labor seven days a week; they changed the Sabbath to Sunday, added daylight saving, and passed same-sex marriage. The time is 250 years.

“And shall wear out the saints of the most High”. How did they wear us out? In slavery: shackles on our necks, our hands and our ankles; buck breaking; working seven days a week from sunup to sundown. That is what wearing out the saints means.

“And they shall be given into his hand until a time and times and the dividing of time”: 250 years. What we need to see in this verse is that he speaks great words against the Most High, and that is their media, the mouth of the serpent casting its flood of lies after the woman.

precepts.text: I beheld till the thrones were cast down, and the Ancient of Days did sit, whose garment was white as snow and the hair of his head like pure wool; his throne was like the fiery flame and his wheels as burning fire; a fiery stream issued before him; thousand thousands ministered unto him; the judgment was set and the books opened; and the beast, America, was slain and given to the burning flame.
precepts.point: The hypocrites of our people: Isaiah 9:16-17, the leaders of this people cause them to err, the religious and political leaders, T.D. Jakes and Pastor P, and they that are led of them are destroyed; the Lord has no joy in their young men nor mercy on their fatherless and widows, for every one is an hypocrite and evil doer and every mouth speaketh folly. They all have the Bible and say they believe in Jesus and do not one word of it.
precepts.why:
“Who among us shall dwell with the devouring fire? who among us shall dwell with everlasting burnings?” What does it mean to dwell with fire? Daniel shows what it is to stand before the Lord in his kingdom.

“I beheld till the thrones were cast down.” Daniel looked in the vision and saw America fall, Britain, Germany, France, Canada and Australia fall, and China, Japan, North Korea and South Korea: all the powerful nations. “And the Ancient of days did sit”: having no beginning of days and no end of days, and in order to sit, you have to have a body. “Whose garment was white as snow”: to wear a garment you have to have a body. “And the hair of his head like the pure wool.” So what is God? A black man.

“His throne was like the fiery flame, and his wheels as burning fire.” His wheels are the chariots of heaven that they call UFOs. “A fiery stream issued and came forth from before him”: fire bursting from the throne at all times. You are not just rolling up on the Lord saying, Lord, I want to talk to you for a minute. You have to get through that fire first. This is going to be a kingdom of absolute order and rule.

“Thousand thousands ministered unto him, and ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him: the judgment was set, and the books were opened. I beheld then because of the voice of the great words which the horn spake: I beheld even till the beast was slain, and his body destroyed, and given to the burning flame.” The horn speaking great words and the beast is America, slain and given to the burning flame.

That is the devouring fire and the everlasting burnings of Isaiah 33. The sinners in Zion are afraid of it, and only he that walketh righteously and speaketh uprightly shall dwell there.

precepts.text: The labour of Egypt, and merchandise of Ethiopia and of the Sabeans: the three ribs.
precepts.point: The three ribs in its mouth are the three nations Persia conquered: Egypt, Ethiopia, and the Sabeans. This kingdom is very significant for what is happening today.
precepts.why:
The second beast is “like to a bear”, and the bear is the Persians and the Medes. “it raised up itself on one side”: Persia raised itself up, because through King Cyrus, Persia became mightier than Media. “and it had three ribs in the mouth of it between the teeth of it”. What three nations do those ribs represent? Isaiah 45:14 answers: “Thus saith the Lord, The labour of Egypt, and merchandise of Ethiopia and of the Sabeans”. The three ribs are Egypt, Ethiopia and the Sabeans, the nations Persia conquered.

This kingdom of Persia and Media is very significant for what is going on today. The Achaemenid Empire of Old Persian was an ancient Iranian empire, founded by Cyrus the Great in 550 BC. The bear of Daniel 7 is Iran.

And the Lord worked through that Persian king. “the Lord stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia”, and Cyrus proclaimed, “The Lord God of heaven hath given me all the kingdoms of the earth; and he hath charged me to build him an house at Jerusalem, which is in Judah.” The Lord spoke to him, and he listened. Isaiah says of him, “He is my shepherd, and shall perform all my pleasure: even saying to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be built; and to the temple, Thy foundation shall be laid.” And the chapter of the three ribs opens, “Thus saith the Lord to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have holden, to subdue nations before him”.

So the Lord used King Cyrus, a Persian, to let us go back and build the temple, and gave him Egypt, Ethiopia and the Sabeans to devour. That is why the bear rose up on one side, and why the land of Persia, Iran, stands in prophecy for the days we are in.

precepts.text: The labour of Egypt, and merchandise of Ethiopia and of the Sabeans, men of stature, shall come over unto thee in chains. The three ribs God promised Cyrus for releasing Israel.
precepts.point: The little horn that came up among them is America, which came out of Britain and plucked up three of the first horns: France, Britain and Spain. Its eyes like the eyes of man are vision, the airplane, the moon landing, the phone, shared with his European brothers and nobody else. Its mouth speaking great things blasphemes the Most High.
precepts.why:
The second beast is “like to a bear, and it raised up itself on one side, and it had three ribs in the mouth of it between the teeth of it”. The bear is Persia and Media, a dual empire, and it raised itself up on one side because Persia rose up greater than the Medes. To explain the three ribs, go to Isaiah 45.

It opens, “Thus saith the Lord to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have holden, to subdue nations before him”. God chose Cyrus the Persian to release the Israelites. And what did Persia receive? “The labour of Egypt”: that is one rib. “and merchandise of Ethiopia”: that is the second. “and of the Sabeans”: that is Somalia, the third. “men of stature”, tall men, “shall come over unto thee, and they shall be thine: they shall come after thee; in chains they shall come over, and they shall fall down unto thee”.

So when the Most High told Cyrus to release his people from captivity, he promised to make him ruler over many nations, and these three are the ribs between the bear's teeth. “and they said thus unto it, Arise, devour much flesh”: that means conquer. The Scripture explains the Scripture; the ribs are not a mystery once you lay the precept beside the vision.

precepts.text: The eagle whom thou sawest come up from the sea is the kingdom seen in the vision of thy brother Daniel, but it was not expounded unto him.
precepts.point: The little horn that came up among them is America, which came out of Britain and plucked up three of the first horns: France, Britain and Spain. Its eyes like the eyes of man are vision, the airplane, the moon landing, the phone, shared with his European brothers and nobody else. Its mouth speaking great things blasphemes the Most High.
precepts.why:
Daniel gives an animal for each of the first three kingdoms: the lion for Babylon, the bear for Persia and Media, the leopard for the Greeks. But for the fourth beast, “dreadful and terrible, and strong exceedingly”, with “great iron teeth”, no animal is named. You have to go to 2 Esdras 12.

“This is the interpretation of the vision: The eagle, whom thou sawest come up from the sea, is the kingdom which was seen in the vision of thy brother Daniel. But it was not expounded unto him, therefore now I declare it unto thee.” The animal symbol Daniel was not shown is the eagle, and it was only revealed to Esdras. That is why it is precept upon precept, line upon line, here a little and there a little. If you don't read the Bible that way, you are going to be confused.

So the fourth beast is Rome, the eagle. It “devoured and brake in pieces, and stamped the residue with the feet of it”: when you stomp on somebody so hard you can see the bootprint on his face. What did they stamp on us? Their philosophies and their doctrines. That is why we wholeheartedly believe Sunday and their days of the week, and all the foolishness the white man has told us. Its ten horns are the same ten horns of Revelation, what we call NATO today.

Esau knows the fourth one is the eagle. That is why the pictures they put out get the first three right and make up some creature for the last, to throw off the so-called black Christians, who sit in the churches saying nobody knows who the fourth kingdom is. The precept in Esdras settles it.

precepts.text: He shall speak great words against the Most High, wear out the saints, and think to change times and laws: daylight saving, a year that begins in dead winter, same-sex marriage, the Sabbath moved to the first day. The saints are given into his hand until a time, times and the dividing of time.
precepts.point: The little horn that came up among them is America, which came out of Britain and plucked up three of the first horns: France, Britain and Spain. Its eyes like the eyes of man are vision, the airplane, the moon landing, the phone, shared with his European brothers and nobody else. Its mouth speaking great things blasphemes the Most High.
precepts.why:
The little horn that came up among the ten is America, which came out of Britain, and it had “a mouth speaking great things.” Verse 25 is still speaking of this same beast and shows what that mouth does: “And he shall speak great words against the most High”. They blasphemed the Lord. They said, if there is a God, he is a white man.

“and shall wear out the saints of the most High”: they wore us out in slavery.

“and think to change times and laws”. Changing times is daylight saving time, and a year that begins in the dead of winter. Changing laws is same-sex laws, you can marry, if it feels good, do it; and the Sabbath moved from the seventh day to the first day of the week. They changed the laws of God.

“and they shall be given into his hand until a time and times and the dividing of time.” The Israelites are given into this man's hands. A time is one, times is two, and the dividing of time makes three and a half.

And the fight against this beast is not a physical one: “For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.” The rulers of the darkness are their governments, with America at the top of the pinnacle, followed by Britain, France and Germany. That is why we don't say Trump is the last one; when he goes, somebody else takes his seat and that spirit jumps on him. There are people behind the scenes, the deep state, the CIA, the FBI and the military officials, telling the president what to do. Republicans and Democrats are two horns on the same beast; it is good cop, bad cop, and the agenda is the same.

precepts.text: The horn that had eyes, and a mouth that spake very great things, whose look was more stout than his fellows: America stronger than all Europe through its technology and military.
precepts.point: In this horn were eyes like the eyes of a man, and a mouth speaking great things. Look at the back of the dollar: an eye set in the separated capstone of the pyramid, a horn with the eye of a man, illuminated. The eye is his wisdom and technology, and his claim to see everything like God. The great mouth is his power to speak across the whole world.

note.label: Cyber Warfare: The Mouth Of The Beast

precepts.why:
Daniel asks to know “the truth of the fourth beast, which was diverse from all the others, exceeding dreadful, whose teeth were of iron, and his nails of brass”. The fourth beast is the fourth kingdom to rise up and rule the earth: it began with Rome, and Europe and America are the extension of Rome. The beast is Edom, the so-called white man.

“And of the ten horns that were in his head, and of the other which came up, and before whom three fell”. The ten horns are the Europeans; when the European Union was first formed it was ten nations, though today it is much more than that. The other horn that came up among them is America, and the three that fell before it are the powers America fought for its independence: France, Spain and Britain. This year America turns 250 years old.

“even of that horn that had eyes, and a mouth that spake very great things”. Look at the back of the dollar bill: the eye of a man set in the top of the pyramid, separated from the rest of it so it looks like a horn, with light illuminating all around it. It is not only the eye of Ra; they put the eyes of a man there. Those eyes are this man's wisdom and his technology, the wisdom Satan gave him. And it is his claim to be God: God sees everything everyone does, and the white man sets himself up as God and says, I see everything.

The great mouth speaks great things: he calls himself the people of God, calls himself a Jew, and says the land of Israel belongs to him. America has spoken many great things against God. And the great mouth is his power to communicate, to speak from one side of the world to the other.

“whose look was more stout than his fellows”: America is stronger than all the European nations. Why? Because of the technology, because of that great mouth and those eyes. Ezekiel shows the same wisdom in the prince of Tyrus, a rich ancient city on the coast of Lebanon that God uses as an analogy for America: “thou hast said, I am a God, I sit in the seat of God”, “yet thou art a man, and not God”. “Behold, thou art wiser than Daniel; there is no secret that they can hide from thee”. With the technology we have, you can talk to someone on the other side of the world and see him on a device. There is no secret you can hide from the white man; every evil you do, everything you buy, he sees it.

“By thy great wisdom and by thy traffick hast thou increased thy riches”: that is how America became rich, through its technology and trade, the system that made the American dollar the dominant dollar in the world. But because he has set his heart “as the heart of God”, God says, “I will bring strangers upon thee, the terrible of the nations: and they shall draw their swords against the beauty of thy wisdom”. That is future prophecy.

precepts.text: The beast is like a leopard, with the feet of a bear and the mouth of a lion.
precepts.point: The three ribs in the bear's mouth are Egypt, Ethiopia and the Sabeans, given for Israel's ransom.

note.label: Pope Nicholas & the Moors of Spain

precepts.why:
John saw “a beast rise up out of the sea, having seven heads and ten horns, and upon his horns ten crowns, and upon his heads the name of blasphemy.” Blasphemy means wicked lies against God, and those lies are written on the heads of this beast. Then he describes it: “And the beast which I saw was like unto a leopard, and his feet were as the feet of a bear, and his mouth as the mouth of a lion”. This is not the old kingdoms themselves; it is a beast rising in the last days that carries the attributes of all three.

The leopard is Greece. Daniel saw “another, like a leopard, which had upon the back of it four wings of a fowl; the beast had also four heads”. The four wings are four armies, the Greek military split four ways, and the four heads are the four generals: Ptolemy, Lysimachus, Cassander and Seleucus.

The bear is the Medo-Persian Empire. It “raised up itself on one side”: Persia rose up over the Medes and became the greater. The “three ribs in the mouth of it” are Egypt, Ethiopia and the Sabeans (that is Somalia), the three nations named in Isaiah 45:14: “The labour of Egypt, and merchandise of Ethiopia and of the Sabeans, men of stature”. The same chapter opens, “Thus saith the Lord to his anointed, to Cyrus”: God raised up Cyrus the Persian to conquer those three nations and take over the world.

The lion is Babylon, the first beast of Daniel 7:4, “like a lion, and had eagle’s wings”. The wings were plucked when Babylon put down Assyria. It was “made stand upon the feet as a man, and a man’s heart was given to it”: great wisdom was given to Babylon.

So the beast of Revelation 13 has elements of Greece, elements of Persia and Media, of Cyrus and those rulers, and the mouth of ancient Babylon. “and the dragon gave him his power, and his seat, and great authority”: Satan gave this kingdom its power and great authority.

That is why the lion of Daniel 7:4 matters today. When you read about Babylon, Persia and Media and the Greeks, certain things in that history are being fulfilled in these last days. Everybody doesn't know that. And the head “wounded to death” is Rome, wounded in the year 193 AD.

precepts.text: The lights of heaven are for signs, seasons, days and years.
precepts.point: The calendar itself was changed.

note.label: Pope Nicholas & the Moors of Spain

precepts.why:
Revelation 13:5 says “there was given unto him a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies”, and Daniel 7:25 says the same: “he shall speak great words against the most High, and shall wear out the saints of the most High”. Revelation 13:7 adds that “it was given unto him to make war with the saints”. The great words are things like the image of Cesare Borgia as Christ, a white man dying for the sins of everybody on the planet, getting dumped in the water to be saved, Lent, Christmas, December 25th and the rest. To wear out the saints is slavery.

“and think to change times and laws”. They changed the time with daylight saving time. They moved the beginning of the year from spring to January. Genesis 1:14 was read to show something else they changed: “Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years”.

Leviticus 23 shows what the seasons are for: “These are the feasts of the Lord, even holy convocations, which ye shall proclaim in their seasons.” The Sabbath is listed first, and it is all year round. Then come the seasonal holidays: Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month, in the spring; the feast of unleavened bread on the fifteenth; Pentecost, counting fifty days; the blowing of trumpets on the first day of the seventh month, the seventh new moon celebration; the day of atonement on the tenth of the seventh month; and the feast of tabernacles on the fifteenth.

Sirach 43:6: “He made the moon also to serve in her season for a declaration of times, and a sign of the world.” The declaration of times is the high holy days. The lights God set in the heaven keep his calendar, and that is the calendar the beast thought to change.

precepts.text: The lesser light rules the night.
precepts.point: The calendar itself was changed.

note.label: Pope Nicholas & the Moors of Spain

precepts.why:
“And God made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: he made the stars also.” The greater light is the sun and the lesser light is the moon. Notice the wording: great lights. He did not make a quarter moon or half a light. He made two great lights. What they call the full moon today is actually the new moon, and many cultures, like the Maya, hold full moon gatherings. Deuteronomy 33:14 speaks of Joseph's land and “the precious things put forth by the moon”, things that come out when the moon is at its peak, like the coquí frogs that come out under the moonlight in the islands where Ephraim and Manasseh dwell.

Sirach 43 goes on: “From the moon is the sign of feasts, a light that decreaseth in her perfection. The month is called after her name, increasing wonderfully in her changing, being an instrument of the armies above, shining in the firmament of heaven”. The word month comes from moon. Every feast starts at the new moon in its brightness, because that is how it was in the kingdom. The armies above are the armies of Revelation 19: “the armies which were in heaven followed him upon white horses”.

The moon is “a sign of the world”. The full moon stands for when we were in our full power and understanding. As it wanes and goes dark, that is us going into captivity, into full darkness, and when it comes back to fullness, that is us going back into our glory, back into the kingdom. Isaiah 60:2: “the darkness shall cover the earth, and gross darkness the people”. When you see the dark moon, that is what it represents: we lost our heritage, and darkness covers the world.

Psalm 82 shows why: “How long will ye judge unjustly”, and because of it, “all the foundations of the earth are out of course.” Even the lights are out of course because of our sins. The seasons are out of order, and if the Sabbath comes every seven days, a month should have twenty-eight days. Isaiah 30:26 shows the kingdom: “Moreover the light of the moon shall be as the light of the sun, and the light of the sun shall be sevenfold, as the light of seven days, in the day that the Lord bindeth up the breach of his people, and healeth the stroke of their wound.” The sun has no phases, so in the kingdom the moon will not go back into darkness. Binding up the breach is gathering the twelve tribes again, as Amos 9:11 says: “In that day will I raise up the tabernacle of David that is fallen, and close up the breaches thereof”.

precepts.text: A king shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in judgment.
precepts.point: A king shall reign in righteousness and princes rule in judgment.
precepts.why:
“But the saints of the most High shall take the kingdom, and possess the kingdom for ever, even for ever and ever.” The saints of the Most High, that is us. We are not going to ask anybody for the kingdom. We are not going to ask permission or say, can I have this. We are going to take it, and possess it for ever and ever.

Isaiah shows how we will rule it: “Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in judgment.” The kingdom the saints take will be ruled in righteousness and judgment, not like the nations that rule us now, weakening nations and taking fields by violence.
